name: Parameters.smul_vacuumDatum_mem_standardData
summary: The named datum is an admissible combination of translates of the integral vacuum (`isAdmissibleComb_name`), whose coefficients become l-integral after the scaling.

steps.claim: Write the vacuum datum as the datum named by Ψ on the integral vacuum: an admissible combination (`isAdmissibleComb_name` with g = N), and the scaled combination lies in the standard data at l (its smul_mem, l coprime to q), each translate lying in the span of the standard generators (the values integral at l by hΨ and the coprimality, `Ideal.IsPrime.notMem_of_isCoprime_of_mem`).
steps.lean:
simpa [intVacuum, comp_def, vacuumDatum] using (isAdmissibleComb_name (g := N) (u :=
    intVacuum _) _ _ (by grind [mul_comm]) (hΨ <| vecToMat ·) le_ciSup rfl).smul_mem (M :=
    standardData ..) hl fun y x ↦ Submodule.subset_span ⟨y, by simpa [integralAfter] using
    (x · · ∘ IsPrime.notMem_of_isCoprime_of_mem hl.cast), by simp [intVacuum]⟩
